clue.text: Cautious, limiting on and off white wine

indicators.note: limiting means enclosing, so the word for cautious holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: chary means cautious or wary

indicators.note: off means wrong or not right, so the letters of 'on and' are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone describes a cautious drinker who sips white wine only now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on and off' looks like it means 'intermittently', but 'off' is the anagram signal working on 'on and', and 'limiting' puts the result inside the word for cautious.
explanation.definitionFit: Chardonnay is a well-known grape variety and the dry wine made from it, always white.

clue.text: Carry On Constable, typically English?

parts.note: a constable is an example of a cop, a police officer

explanation.surface: Is the film Carry On Constable a typically English comedy?
explanation.walkthrough: The Carry On films are a long-running series of British comedies; 'Carry On' here is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To cope is to manage or keep going despite difficulties, which is to carry on.

clue.text: Removing top, intimate friend

indicators.note: in a down answer the top is the first letter, which is taken away

parts.note: pally means friendly or intimate

explanation.surface: An intimate friend takes their top off.
explanation.definitionFit: An ally is someone on your side, a supporter or companion.

clue.text: Choosing committee for project's planning stage

parts.note: drawing, as in drawing lots, means choosing
a board is a committee that runs an organisation

explanation.surface: A selection committee is appointed for an early phase of a project.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan still 'on the drawing board' is at its design phase, before any work is done.

clue.text: Genuine new Lloyd Webber musical mounted

indicators.note: mounted means going up, so in a down answer the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: Evita is a musical by Andrew Lloyd Webber

explanation.surface: An authentic new Lloyd Webber show is put on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounted' looks like staging a production, but in a down clue it turns EVITA upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Native means natural or inborn, as in native wit, so true and authentic.

clue.text: Sign of a university in Iraq upsetting America

indicators.note: in means the university letter is placed inside
upsetting means turning upside down, so in a down answer the country is read upwards

parts.note: US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: Evidence of a university in Iraq unsettling the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsetting' reverses IRAQ to QARI, and U goes in to make QUARI.
explanation.definitionFit: Aquarius, the water carrier, is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac.

clue.text: Understand point of view

definitions.meaning: to ... something a certain way is to understand or interpret it
your ... on a matter is your opinion or angle on it

explanation.surface: Grasp another person's perspective.
explanation.definitionFit: Take as a verb is to grasp a meaning; as a noun it is a personal opinion or slant.

clue.text: Stories Dan concocted, displaying skill

indicators.note: concocted means made up or mixed together, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Dan shows his talent by making up tales.
explanation.definitionFit: Adroitness is dexterity or cleverness, the quality of being adept.

clue.text: Trees always succeeded hiding part of golf course

indicators.note: hiding means concealing, so the first pieces wrap round the golf word

parts.note: ever means always
the green is the area of short grass around the hole

explanation.surface: Trees on a golf course always manage to hide part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Evergreens are trees that keep their leaves all year, such as pines and holly.

clue.text: Bloomer youth plans to remedy

indicators.note: to remedy something is to fix it, so these letters are put right by being rearranged

explanation.surface: A blunder made by a young person, which their plans set out to correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder, but it means a flowering plant here.
explanation.definitionFit: A polyanthus is a garden primula grown for its bright flowers, so it is literally something that blooms.

clue.text: Lawyer discards fine cheese

indicators.note: discards means throws away, so a letter is removed from the word for lawyer

parts.note: a brief is informal British slang for a barrister or lawyer
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A lawyer turns down some excellent cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fine' looks like praise for the cheese but gives F. A brief is British slang for a lawyer.
explanation.definitionFit: Brie is a soft French cheese with a white rind, a classic example of the type.

clue.text: Right to block incorrect grade in Kent school

indicators.note: to block means to get in the way of, so the letter sits inside the other letters
incorrect signals the letters are wrongly ordered and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A wrong mark at a Kent school gets corrected.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is an English county; 'in Kent' looks like a location but is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A kindergarten is a nursery school for young children, before primary school.

clue.text: Redeeming feature of change by Heather around home

parts.note: silver is loose change, coins of small value

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the word for heather goes round the word for home

parts.note: ling is another name for common heather
in means at home

explanation.surface: Someone named Heather made a change at home that saved the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name but is the plant, ling.
explanation.definitionFit: From 'every cloud has a silver lining': a hopeful aspect within a bad situation.

clue.text: Plant that stings adults cuts little child

indicators.note: cuts means slices into, so the pieces go into the word for a small child

parts.note: a tot is a little child
ouch is what you say when something stings
men are adults

explanation.surface: A stinging plant hurts grown-ups and wounds a small child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that stings' looks like part of the definition of a nettle, but it gives OUCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Touch-me-not is a name for balsam plants whose ripe pods burst when touched.

clue.text: Places where track athletes can make a splash?

definitions.text: Places where track athletes can make a splash?

parts.words: Places where track athletes can make a splash
parts.note: make a splash means to impress, but literally these hurdles land runners in water

explanation.surface: Where on the track can runners make a big impression?
explanation.walkthrough: 'make a splash' is an idiom for being a success; here it is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: These are steeplechase barriers with a pool behind them that runners land in.

clue.text: Ape beginning to eat fruit

parts.note: orang is short for orang-utan, the great ape

indicators.note: beginning to means the first letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: An ape starts tucking into some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: An orange is a common citrus fruit.

clue.text: Manual inspiring African politicians to show leadership

indicators.note: inspiring is read as breathing in, so the manual takes the politicians inside it

parts.note: a guide is a manual or handbook
the ANC is the African National Congress, South Africa's ruling party

explanation.surface: A handbook that motivates African politicians to lead well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspiring' looks like 'motivating', but here it means breathing in, so the manual takes the politicians inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Guidance is direction or advice given by those in charge, a near synonym of leadership.

clue.text: Impedes Taliban capturing base

indicators.note: capturing means holding within, so the answer is found inside these words

explanation.surface: Something obstructs the Taliban as they seize a military base.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedestal is the stand or plinth on which a statue or column rests.

clue.text: Constant support mostly comprising brave individual, Native American

indicators.note: comprising means containing, so the outer letters hold the brave person inside

parts.note: c is the symbol for a constant such as the speed of light

indicators.note: mostly means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: keep means support or maintain someone financially
a hero is a brave individual

explanation.surface: A long description of a dependable Native American warrior.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims KEEP to KEE; 'brave' tempts as the Native American warrior word but here it goes with 'individual' to give HERO.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cherokee are a Native American people originally from the south-eastern United States.

clue.text: Nick is about to back proportional representation

indicators.note: to back means to come behind, so these words follow the abbreviation

parts.note: PR is the abbreviation for proportional representation, a voting system
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A politician declares support for a fairer voting system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' is British slang for a jail, and 'to back' looks like 'to support' but means coming behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Nick is British slang for a jail or a police station, so it means prison.

clue.text: Falsify getting infiltrated by unknown country

indicators.note: getting infiltrated by means another piece gets inside this word

parts.note: to belie is to misrepresent or give a false idea of
z is a mathematical symbol for an unknown quantity

explanation.surface: A spy falsifies records while an unknown nation sneaks in agents.
explanation.definitionFit: Belize is a nation in Central America, bordering Mexico and Guatemala.

clue.text: PM meets popular army officer

parts.note: John Major was the British Prime Minister in the 1990s
general means popular or widespread, held by most people

explanation.surface: A prime minister meets a well-liked military man.
explanation.walkthrough: John Major was UK Prime Minister from 1990 to 1997.
explanation.definitionFit: A major general is a senior rank in the army, above brigadier.

clue.text: Reportedly full agreement

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard said, so the answer sounds like the word for full

parts.note: packed means full, crammed

explanation.surface: News says the deal is complete.
explanation.definitionFit: A pact is a formal deal or treaty between parties.

clue.text: Demands regularly to succeed hotel manager

indicators.note: to succeed means to follow after, so these letters come after the hotel letter

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A hotel manager makes constant demands for success.
explanation.definitionFit: A head is a person in charge, such as a head teacher or departmental chief.

clue.text: Greek character, doctor, lacking any feeling

parts.note: nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A Greek doctor shows no sympathy for patients.
explanation.definitionFit: Numb describes being without sensation, unable to sense anything physically or emotionally.

clue.text: Stage performance barely entertaining the audience?

definitions.text: Stage performance barely entertaining the audience?

parts.words: Stage performance barely entertaining the audience
parts.note: barely seems to mean hardly, but it means without clothes: the act entertains while getting bare

explanation.surface: A dull theatre show that hardly amuses the spectators.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barely' reads as 'scarcely', but the show entertains by its performer becoming bare.
explanation.definitionFit: This act involves a performer removing clothes gradually before a watching crowd.

clue.text: Son gets drunk over casual fling

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: a sot is a drunkard

explanation.surface: A young man gets drunk and ends up in a brief romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' reverses S + SOT. 'fling' looks romantic but means a throw.
explanation.definitionFit: A toss is a light, careless throw, which is what a casual fling of a ball would be.

clue.text: Took turns with Bill tackling terribly late rent

indicators.note: tackling means taking hold of, so the bill wraps round the other letters

parts.note: an ad is a bill or advertisement poster

indicators.note: terribly signals the letters are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: Bill takes on a tenant who is dreadfully behind with the rent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name but is AD, a poster; 'terribly' rearranges LATE RENT into LTERNATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To alternate is to do something in rotation with another person, swapping back and forth.
